about: Every slot of the film, in order. A slot with no clip renders a labelled slate, so the film always plays. Times are seconds from the start of the film. The story is demo-video/docs/STORY.md; the nine AI shots and their hand-over are demo-video/docs/SHOTS.md.

names.about: Draft 2 (V17). Spoken as Rahm (audio/script.json, spoken). night_time is the sleeper's label in the hook; the night clock of the proof starts from it. peer_face (Draft 3, V20): the Peer's one face, Ram's portrait with the mark as a badge, on the hook's cards and the tag (the screens take it from screens.json).

reveal-desk.about: Draft 2's walk to the desk (WP3, final v1). Draft 3 plays only its stretch from 4.2 s on: before that, threads of light join him to the sleeper, the ghost Manish ruled out (V19, V20). reveal-desk-sit and reveal-work borrow it, with WP3's tag track, last still and screen corners.

slots.shows: Daytime, a bright office. A colleague looks up from her phone, surprised: Ram's AI Peer has answered her, and it is 2 AM where he lives.

card.text: Yes, the numbers are final. The sheet is in our team folder.

slots.edit: Draft 2 (V17): WP2-3's own take (demo-video/shots/hook-1/requests/hook-1-raw-r1.json, WP3's route), the line pinned at 0.9 s of the take; own_clip keeps tools/pull_shots.mjs from putting WP3's clip back.

slots.shows: Late afternoon, another city, a small meeting room. A colleague reads his update, surprised and pleased: Ram is out of office, and his AI Peer sent it.

card.text: Your update: the new screens are done, and the review is now on Thursday.

slots.edit: Draft 2 (V17): WP2-3's own take (demo-video/shots/hook-2/requests/hook-2-raw-r1.json), as hook-1.

slots.shows: Evening, a third place, a home desk under a lamp. A colleague leans back, half laughing, and asks if he ever sleeps.
Cut to night. Ram is fast asleep; his name and the night time show beside him.
slots.edit: Draft 3 (V20), wp2-6: WP3's final v1 with the phone on the bedside table lighting up at 14.2 s (right after p01), so the phone reads as where the Peer comes from; made on this Mac by demo-video/tools/phone_glow.py (--on 3.5 clip seconds), which follows the camera's drift. The phone's buzz is at 14.2 (audio/mix.json).

slots.shows: The night room. The phone on the bedside table glows; a ribbon of mint light streams out of it across the floor, and the Peer takes shape beside the desk, with Ram's look (V20, concept A). Never out of Ram's body.
slots.edit: Draft 3 (V20): the ribbon leaves the phone at 15.5, he is formed by 18.0, just before p02 (18.32). Only its first 3.0 s (wp2-6): after that its ribbon arcs over Ram's head back into the phone, so reveal-gather takes over at 18.0 (this clip plays on 0.15 s under the dissolve). Made by wp2-5: demo-video/shots/reveal-a/ (route K, Kling 4.0, key frames e0, e1, e2 on the room of Draft 2's desk clip).

slots.shows: The ribbon's last light flows into him, low over the floor, never over the bed; formed, he turns to the desk and steps to the chair.
slots.edit: Draft 3 (V20), wp2-6: one take from reveal-phone's frame at 3.0 s, through e2-clean (e2 without its sparkles over Ram's head, at about 2.5 s) to Draft 2's desk clip at 4.2 s, where reveal-desk-sit picks up (route K, Kling 4.0, 5 s: demo-video/shots/reveal-a/requests/k-gather.json). Replaces reveal-walk, whose first 1.5 s had sparkles over Ram's head. Played at 0.96x so it plays on 0.15 s under reveal-desk-sit's dissolve.

tag_keys.about: Keys by hand (wp2-6, near the mint glow's centre; the last two as wp2-5's for the same pose at the chair), followed by tools/tag_track.py. The tag lands as he says 'AI Peer' (18.6, as before) and stays to the chair.

slots.shows: He sits and opens the laptop; the screen lights.
slots.edit: Draft 3: 4.2 to 8.0 s of the clip (no threads in it), a little faster than life, picking up where reveal-gather ends. The lid's click is at 26.05 s (audio/mix.json).

slots.shows: He works at the laptop while the camera moves in on him, on the line of the push-in that follows.
slots.edit: The clip's last two seconds of work (8.0 to 10.0 s) played forward and back by a clip the build makes, so this shot takes any length: it is the reveal's spare time.

tag_keys.about: On while the Peer says 'Not as him. As me.' (28.2 to 29.87 s); 'force' as he sits side-on.

slots.shows: The camera pushes into the laptop screen, into the real product. Made by code from the last frame of reveal-desk.

hand_quads.about: The four corners of the laptop's screen in the last frame of the shot before, clockwise from the top left, as fractions of the frame: set by hand per clip, used only while WP3's manifest gives no screen_quad.

slots.shows: The real meeting. It joins as a labelled AI, says it is an AI, gives his update, answers a question, and brings back what needs his judgment.
Real Slack at night. A colleague's question, answered with its sources, and no promise made for him.
The other direction. One change elsewhere in the company that touches his project, caught and brought to him.
The same room at sunrise, warm light through the window. He wakes rested, sits up and picks up his phone.
The morning brief from the real product: what the Peer did, what it learned, and the one thing that needs him.
He reads the brief on his phone and decides with one tap.
In the sunlit room the Peer, by the desk, smiles at Ram, then flows back as a ribbon of light into the phone in Ram's hand, where the brief waits (V20: it goes back where it came from).
slots.edit: Draft 3 (V20), replacing Draft 2's morning-nod: he smiles 0.3 to 1.5 s of the clip, flows into the phone 1.5 to 3.2, the phone glows to 3.8. Made by wp2-5: demo-video/shots/return-a/ (route K, Kling 4.0, key frames r0, a-phone-3-back, r2).

tag_keys.about: Keys by hand (wp2-5), followed by tools/tag_track.py; the tag fades as he turns into the ribbon.

slots.shows: The camera pulls out of one lit window, over the city, up to the Earth from space. On the night side, mint lights come on across the dark cities.
The AI Peer mark, the line "More room for your best work.", and "Built for real this week".

narration.about: Where each spoken line starts, in film seconds. A hook line whose shot arrives lip-synced takes its time from the clip instead (SHOTS.md, line_at_s).
